evidence.title: Moonmail — postcards from the Moon
evidence.problem: People wish they could get mail from the Moon but they can't because nobody lives there.
evidence.solution: We set up a PO box in Moon, Pennsylvania. You write a postcard to yourself, we mail it to the Moon PO box, then mail it back to you with a Moon postmark. Subscription is 29 dollars a month and you get one postcard a month from the Moon.
evidence.market: Everyone. There are 8 billion people and all of them would like mail from the Moon. If 1 percent subscribe that is 80 million customers paying 29 dollars a month.
evidence.business_model: 29 dollars a month subscription. Postage costs about 1.50 so the rest is profit.
evidence.traction: I told my roommate and he said it was funny.
evidence.competition: NASA does not do this. Nobody does this.
evidence.team: Just me. I have never run a business but I am very motivated and I own a printer.
evidence.risks: The post office might not let us call it the Moon. Also the Moon PO box might fill up.
evidence.ask: How fast can this get to a billion dollar valuation?

goal.founder_question: How fast can this get to a billion dollar valuation?
